syllabus_extract: Basics of EMI and EMC. Types of testing.
specific_objectives: 26.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the basic theory of communication.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of EMI/EMC definitions and testing types from IB/PDF; Instructor supervision required for Q&A verification.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a communication system?
Define the term 'noise' in a signal context.
Why is signal integrity critical for aircrew operations?

topics: Sources of EMI in aircraft systems
Impact of EMI on avionics performance
development.content:
Definition of Electromagnetic Interference
Sources of EMI in aircraft systems
Impact of EMI on avionics performance
Basic principles of Electromagnetic Compatibility
Distinction between emission and susceptibility

Types of EMI testing procedures
Radiated emission testing methods
Conducted emission testing methods
Susceptibility testing protocols
Standard compliance requirements for aircraft

Shielding techniques for cable bundles
Grounding and bonding best practices
Filtering components in power systems
Common mode chokes application
Maintenance checks for EMC integrity

summary_questions: Explain the relationship between EMI and EMC in aircraft systems.
Identify two common sources of interference in a cockpit environment.
Describe the purpose of shielding in reducing electromagnetic coupling.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles of EMC discussed in this lesson apply to the upcoming Sonar system introduction in LP 05.

pft_rows.syllabus: Introduction to sonar system. Purpose and technical details of active and passive sonar system.
